text:
sam r: kicking off a narrow cohort rollout for ff `cohort-priority-route`. plan: 0% -> 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% with short holds and telemetry gates. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/KB/cohort-priority-route
dez o: ack. window 01:00-02:00 UTC. gates: p95 latency, error-rate, and targeted QA checks. rollback if p95 +18% for 4m or errors >1.4x baseline.
deploy-bot: job 7200 queued by sam r. image: rwd/cohort-route:v20260327. dry-run ok.
sam r: will pin fallback config so we can unpin quickly if needed. dez, can you apply?
dez o: pinned routing.fallback -> v1-fallback via `rwdctl config set routing.fallback v1 --pin`.
deploy-bot: applying ff cohort-priority-route -> 0.5% (seed cohort).
product-qa: running a quick smoke list on the seed cohort. focusing on short-context and auth edge cases.
sre-oncall: watching infra. autopause rule configured: p95 delta 22% for 3m.
dez o: seeing slight p99 jitter on batchers, p95 okay. no errors.
product-qa: smoke looks good. no auth regressions.
sam r: hold 10m, then proceed to 3% if green.
deploy-bot: ramping ff -> 3% applied. cohorts updated.
dez o: after ramp, one replica showing sustained higher mem (router-7). pulling logs.
sre-oncall: investigating; looks like a KV cache miss storm on router-7.
sam r: do not rollback. prepare a micro-patch to reduce cache retention for new route and canary it. image rwd/cohort-route:v20260327b ready.
deploy-bot: initiating canary swap on router-7 to v20260327b.
dez o: patched pod stabilized. mem back to normal. recommend proceed to 15% but with a targeted long-context reduction for cohorts >8%.
sam r: apply targeted tweak: `rwdctl ff tweak cohort-priority-route --cohort-threshold 8 --long-context-weight 0.5` to reduce exposure.
deploy-bot: cohort tweak applied.
product-qa: re-running focused long-context tests on adjusted cohorts. small regressions noted on one edge slice (~0.7%), adding to ticket #2468.
sre-oncall: overall p95 at 15% is +9%, errors steady. autopause not triggered.
sam r: ramping to 15% now. keep oncall watching and QA owning the ticket.
deploy-bot: ff cohort-priority-route -> 15% applied. cohorts updated.
dez o: after ramp, p95 long-context trending up slowly to +14% in a subset of traffic. still below rollback threshold but close.
product-qa: regression slice isolated. product team requested a pause to add an extra targeted eval tomorrow.
sam r: pausing further rollout. marking rollout state as PAUSED at 15% to add extra tests. leaving flag at 15% and pinned fallback in place.
release-bot: rollout status updated: PAUSED @15% due to quality watch. link: https://release.redwood/status/7200
sre-oncall: acknowledged. prepared rollback snippet and graceful drain step in runbook: `rwdctl ff set cohort-priority-route 0 --reason "paused-quality" && kubectl rollout restart deploy/router-v1`
dez o: archiving relevant logs to s3://redwood-logs/7200/ for postmortem.
sam r: thanks all. will follow up in the AM with product and QA. if metrics worsen overnight, run the rollback playbook. :eyes:
